construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

CEQA notice (2018) describes three buildings over an underground garage: R1, 10 stories plus penthouse, 119 apartments and about 4,255 sq ft retail; R2, 10 stories, 325 apartments; C1, 9 stories, about 290,140 sq ft office, at least 3,960 sq ft retail and a 5,000 sq ft galleria/lobby. SCH 2014092061.

Site is bounded by the Millbrae Intermodal Station (east), El Camino Real and Serra Avenue (west) and Linden Avenue (south), with homes on Hemlock Avenue and a commercial property at 210 El Camino Real to the north.
ENR (2019-11-26) lists the project at 862,621 sq ft across three buildings, including a 279,100 sq ft office and retail building, valued at $200 million.
